columns.<config_id>: matched vulnerabilities in the application (of n_vulns)

basis: main runs; one run per configuration and application
derivation_note: Per-application counts; not printed in the paper's body. Produced by the VulnBench 2.0 analysis pipeline, which verifies the archive's SHA-256, extracts it, and re-scores every run with a re-implementation of the public scorer that reproduces every recorded scoring decision; this file is a selection and renaming of the pipeline's output.
empty_cells: An empty cell means not applicable or unavailable as stated in `columns`; it never means zero.
